meta.encoding: hex unless the field name says otherwise; *Base64/*B64 are standard base64 with padding

bip39.name: a known 24-word English mnemonic to its 64-byte seed
bip39.mnemonic: audit vapor excuse note pledge rough bundle start regular burden reveal theme bachelor bag speed print guess session grit first smoke urge save bicycle
bip39.pins: the literal salt is the ASCII string `mnemonic` with NO passphrase appended

bip39.name: the same mnemonic with mixed case, doubled spaces and outer padding
bip39.mnemonic: AUDIT  vapor  excuse  NOTE  pledge  rough  BUNDLE  start  regular  BURDEN  reveal  theme  BACHELOR  bag  speed  PRINT  guess  session  GRIT  first  smoke  URGE  save  bicycle
bip39.canonicalised: audit vapor excuse note pledge rough bundle start regular burden reveal theme bachelor bag speed print guess session grit first smoke urge save bicycle
bip39.pins: the five normalisation steps of chapter 01 §1.3, and that they change nothing for an already-canonical phrase

bip39.name: a mnemonic with a deliberately invalid checksum
bip39.mnemonic: audit vapor excuse note pledge rough bundle start regular burden reveal theme bachelor bag speed print guess session grit first smoke urge save zoo
bip39.pins: validation MUST gate derivation: no seed may be derived from this

bip39.name: a 12-word mnemonic
bip39.mnemonic: audit vapor excuse note pledge rough bundle start regular burden reveal they
bip39.pins: a 12-word phrase is VALID BIP39 and MUST still be rejected: the product generates 24 words, and accepting 12 halves the entropy silently

verifiers.name: recoveryPhraseUnlock — the whole chain FR-019 ships
verifiers.mnemonic: audit vapor excuse note pledge rough bundle start regular burden reveal theme bachelor bag speed print guess session grit first smoke urge save bicycle
verifiers.pins: phrase → seed → master key → vault key → verifier, in one case

verifiers.name: accountKeyVerifier — no hash wrapper, and a STRING comparison
verifiers.comparison: constant-time over the base64 STRINGS re-encoded as UTF-8, not over the decoded bytes
verifiers.pins: an implementation that compares decoded bytes accepts every correct input and fails to reject some incorrect ones

verifiers.name: localVaultKeyVerifier — keyed BLAKE2b, never sent to the server
verifiers.pins: the vault key is the KEY and the context string is the MESSAGE — the one place a vaultId touches key material

verifiers.name: wrongPhrase — valid BIP39, wrong account
verifiers.mnemonic: zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo vote
verifiers.pins: FR-027: the failure path. Nothing is persisted before the verifier passes

verifiers.name: deviceId — the locally derived form
verifiers.pins: 32 lowercase hex characters. The WIRE identity is the server-assigned id, not this one (chapter 01 §1.5)
